toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.

content.thinking:
I'll save this as an SVG file in the working directory, designing a scene with a rotating unicycle wheel, an anteater character with a tapered snout and raised arms, and three juggled bottles animated in arcs.

Working out coordinates for the wheel, seat, post, body, head, snout, tail, legs, and raised arms...

Staggering three bottles with offset begin times along the same loop path gives a cascading juggling effect, which should read fine for a cartoon. I'm modeling each bottle as a group with body and neck shapes centered at the origin, then using animateMotion to translate it along the arc.

I'll add a nested rotation to each bottle group so it spins mid-flight, then position the anteater's arms so the hands line up with the path endpoints near the bottle's catch points. For the overall motion I'll bob the upper body slightly while keeping the wheel rotation separate, and skip extra ground detail to keep things simple before writing the file.

arguments.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" width="400" height="300">
  <title>Anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>

  <!-- Sky and ground -->
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#bfe6ff"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="45" r="22" fill="#ffd54a"/>
  <rect y="262" width="400" height="38" fill="#7cc46b"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="262" x2="400" y2="262" stroke="#5a9c4f" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="20 10">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="-60" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>

  <!-- Unicycle wheel (spins) -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="200" cy="208" r="50" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="6"/>
    <g>
      <line x1="200" y1="158" x2="200" y2="258" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="150" y1="208" x2="250" y2="208" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="164" y1="172" x2="236" y2="244" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="236" y1="172" x2="164" y2="244" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 200 208" to="-360 200 208" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="200" cy="208" r="5" fill="#888"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Frame and pedal crank -->
  <line x1="200" y1="208" x2="200" y2="150" stroke="#444" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="185" y1="208" x2="215" y2="208" stroke="#444" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="186" y="142" width="30" height="8" rx="4" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Anteater (bobs gently) -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -3;0 0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M160 112 Q120 100 118 70 Q117 58 128 62 Q130 90 166 102 Z" fill="#8a6a4f"/>

    <!-- Legs -->
    <path d="M190 128 L196 146" stroke="#6b4f3a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M212 128 L206 146" stroke="#6b4f3a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="106" rx="40" ry="26" fill="#a47c5c"/>

    <!-- Raised juggling arms -->
    <path d="M186 96 Q168 80 152 62" stroke="#6b4f3a" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M214 96 Q232 80 248 62" stroke="#6b4f3a" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Head and long snout -->
    <circle cx="236" cy="86" r="18" fill="#a47c5c"/>
    <path d="M250 80 L332 96 Q336 100 332 104 L250 98 Z" fill="#8a6a4f"/>
    <path d="M324 92 L334 96 L324 102 Z" fill="#4a3728"/>
    <circle cx="242" cy="80" r="3" fill="#222"/>
    <path d="M226 74 Q232 70 238 74" stroke="#4a3728" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Juggled bottles (cascade over the same arc) -->
  <g>
    <!-- Bottle 1 -->
    <g>
      <animateMotion dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s" path="M152 62 Q200 -10 248 62 Q200 -10 152 62"/>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <rect x="-7" y="-10" width="14" height="20" rx="4" fill="#2e8b57"/>
        <rect x="-3" y="-18" width="6" height="9" rx="2" fill="#2e8b57"/>
        <rect x="-5" y="-3" width="10" height="5" fill="#dff5e6"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- Bottle 2 -->
    <g>
      <animateMotion dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-0.4s" path="M152 62 Q200 -10 248 62 Q200 -10 152 62"/>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <rect x="-7" y="-10" width="14" height="20" rx="4" fill="#d9822b"/>
        <rect x="-3" y="-18" width="6" height="9" rx="2" fill="#d9822b"/>
        <rect x="-5" y="-3" width="10" height="5" fill="#fff1dc"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- Bottle 3 -->
    <g>
      <animateMotion dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-0.8s" path="M152 62 Q200 -10 248 62 Q200 -10 152 62"/>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <rect x="-7" y="-10" width="14" height="20" rx="4" fill="#3b6fd6"/>
        <rect x="-3" y="-18" width="6" height="9" rx="2" fill="#3b6fd6"/>
        <rect x="-5" y="-3" width="10" height="5" fill="#e3ecff"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

content.text:
I created the animated SVG at `anteater-unicycle.svg` in the working directory.

It includes:
- **Unicycle wheel** that spins continuously, with a frame, seat, and pedal crank.
- **Anteater** with a long snout, raised arms, a curled tail, and a gentle bobbing motion.
- **Three juggled bottles** (green, orange, blue) cycling through an arc above the anteater's hands, each spinning as it moves.
- **Scrolling ground** with dashed markings to suggest forward motion.

I haven't opened it in a browser to check the rendering, so the bottle timing and arm positions may need small tweaks. Open the file in any modern browser to view the animation.
